articles.title: HP Guv Kavinder releases books on Dogri theatre
articles.summary: JAMMU, Oct 20: The Governor of Himachal Pradesh, Kavinder Gupta today released three books on Dogri theatre authored, adapted and translated by noted theatre director and playwright Dr Sudhir Mahajan. The three books-Trai Dogri Natak, Char Bal Natak and a collection of translated and adapted plays-bring together nine plays covering a wide range of social, historical, philosophical and contemporary themes.

articles.title: Gujarat Dy CM holds investment talks with Japanese industry representatives
articles.summary: AHMEDABAD, Oct 20: Gujarat Deputy Chief Minister Harsh Sanghavi held a series of high-level meetings with leading global companies, including Ultrafabrics, Kaneka, Nippon Steel, and Itochu Corporation in Tokyo on Tuesday. articles.title: GCCs emerging top career choice for tech talent: Survey
articles.summary: Indian technology professionals are increasingly looking for employers that offer hands-on artificial intelligence (AI) experience and clearly defined career paths, while multinational global capability centres (GCCs) are emerging as the preferred next career move for many, according to a Talent500 survey. Talent500 is part of ANSR, which has set up more than 200 GCCs in India.

articles.title: Delhi Police transfers second case against jailed party leaders to Crime Branch
articles.summary: Delhi Police transferred a second case against jailed Cockroach Janta Party leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka to the Crime Branch on Tuesday. The leaders were detained on October 13 after allegedly trespassing into the denotified Jantar Mantar area in New Delhi. Both remain in judicial custody following the incident involving unauthorized entry and breach of peace bonds.

articles.title: Punjab govt hands over Parvinder Singh Jhota case to CBI on family’s demand

articles.title: On a High-way: India revamps highway EPC rules with rating-based deposits, crash penalties
articles.summary: The Centre has revised performance security measures for national highway contractors based on their ratings. Contractors rated above 80% will deposit 3% of project value, while lower-rated contractors will deposit 4% or 5%. This initiative aims to incentivize quality in highway construction and improve contractors' cash flow. Additionally, higher standards for land acquisition and compensation mechanisms have been established.

articles.title: J&K Government to shift offices to Jammu on November 2
articles.summary: According to a government order, offices observing a five-day week will close after office hours on October 30, while those following a six-day week will close on October 31. All offices will reopen in Jammu on November 2. The Darbar Move practice involves shifting the government’s functioning between Srinagar and Jammu according to the season.

articles.title: Indian students worry AI prioritising speed over deep learning: Report
articles.summary: A new survey reveals that a significant majority of Indian students are worried that while AI enhances speed in learning, it may compromise their deep understanding of the material. The report highlights the need for better educational frameworks to address these concerns and develop durable skills for the future job market.

articles.title: Ranveer Singh Deepika Padukone name their second daughter ‘Devi Padukone Singh’
articles.summary: Ranveer Singh and Deepika Padukone have named their second daughter Devi Padukone Singh. The couple announced the name on Dussehra through a joint social media post featuring the family, including their elder daughter, Dua. Mumbai: Bollywood’s power couple Ranveer Singh and Deepika Padukone have unveiled the name of their second daughter on the auspicious occasion of Dussehra.

articles.title: PM Modi Performs Ravan Dahan in Delhi, Shoots Symbolic Arrow at Ravana’s Effigy
articles.summary: The ritual marked Vijayadashami, which symbolises the triumph of good over evil. The ceremony was part of the capital’s wider Dussehra celebrations, featuring Ramlila performances and the symbolic burning of Ravana’s effigy. The festival commemorates Lord Ram’s victory over Ravana and serves as a reminder of the enduring significance of truth, righteousness and justice.

articles.title: Romania Parliament Approves Pro-European Government Led By Luca Niculescu
articles.summary: The Romanian parliament approved a new government led by pro-European prime minister-designate Luca Niculescu on Tuesday, ending months of political deadlock. Niculescu secured 280 votes for his cabinet, which includes Social Democratic Party ministers and technocrats. The appointment aims to restore stability in the European Union and North Atlantic Treaty Organization member state bordering Ukraine amidst rising regional security threats.
articles.title_hi: रोमानिया की संसद ने लुका निकुलेस्कु के नेतृत्व वाली यूरोपीय समर्थक सरकार को मंजूरी दे दी

articles.title_hinglish: romaniya ki sansada ne luka nikulesku ke netritva vali yuropiya samarthaka sarakara ko manjuri de di
articles.summary_hinglish: romaniyaee sansada ne mangalavara ko yuropiya samarthaka manonita pradhana mantri luka nikulesku ke netritva men eka naee sarakara ko manjuri de di, jisase mahinon ka rajanitika gatirodha samapta ho gaya। nikulesku ne apane mantrimandala ke lie 280 vota hasila kie, jisamen soshala demokretika parti ke mantri aura teknokreta shamila hain। niyukti ka uddeshya badhate kshetriya suraksha khataron ke bicha yukrena ki sima se lage yuropiya sangha aura uttari atalantika sandhi sangathana ke sadasya rajya men sthirata bahala karana hai।

articles.title: AI, geopolitical tensions pose growing risks to financial stability: Experts at RBI SAMVAD
articles.summary: Meanwhile, Department of Economic Affairs Secretary Anuradha Thakur highlighted India's relatively strong position amid global uncertainty. She stressed that India faces the challenging global environment from a "position of macroeconomic stability", supported by a credible fiscal trajectory and flexible inflation targeting. The seminar also examined the future of digital payments, particularly challenges surrounding AI-driven transactions and cross-border payment systems.

articles.title: 'Where are the fans?': David Warner fumes over sparse crowds in South Africa-Australia
articles.summary: The ongoing Test series between South Africa and Australia has sparked a debate over the popularity of red-ball cricket, with former Australian opener David Warner expressing disappointment over the lack of spectators at the venues. Despite featuring the world's top two Test teams, the series has struggled to draw sizeable crowds, prompting Warner to question whether the format is thriving.

articles.title: What is Daler Mehndi's net worth? Minister Subodh Uniyal claims singer got ₹35 lakh
articles.summary: Punjabi singer Daler Mehndi is in the spotlight after a controversy over his performance at a Navratri event in Uttarakhand, where state cabinet minister Subodh Uniyal publicly reprimanded him on stage. The minister has since claimed that the singer was paid ₹ 35 lakh for the performance but failed to deliver as expected.

articles.title: Life leke dikhao: Kanika challenges Arishfa after she pours water on her bed
articles.summary: Tensions escalated inside the Bigg Boss 20 house during the 44th episode following a confrontation between contestants Kanika Mann and Arishfa Khan. The conflict began over Arishfa’s conduct toward several housemates, which she described as retaliation after losing a life in a game task. The friction increased after Arishfa poured water on the beds belonging to Kanika, Gullu, and Mahi.

articles.title: Dombivli GRP Arrests Man In Bihar 28 Years After Brother-In-Law’s Murder Over Divorce
